title: MonsterMQ
description: MonsterMQ MQTT Broker & Industrial Gateway Configuration Schema

TCP.title: MQTT TCP Port
TCP.description: Plain MQTT TCP listening port (default: 1883, set to 0 to disable)

WS.title: MQTT WebSocket Port
WS.description: MQTT over WebSocket listening port (default: 0 disabled, commonly 1884)

TCPS.title: MQTT TLS Port
TCPS.description: MQTT over TLS/SSL TCP listening port (default: 0 disabled, commonly 8883). Requires SSL KeyStore configuration.

WSS.title: MQTT Secure WebSocket Port
WSS.description: MQTT over Secure WebSocket listening port (default: 0 disabled, commonly 8884). Requires SSL KeyStore configuration.

NodeName.title: Cluster Node Name
NodeName.description: Custom node name for cluster identification and log prefixing (defaults to hostname if omitted)

MaxPublishRate.title: Max Publish Rate
MaxPublishRate.description: Maximum messages per second a single client can publish before being throttled (0 = unlimited)

MaxSubscribeRate.title: Max Subscribe Rate
MaxSubscribeRate.description: Maximum messages per second delivered to a single client (0 = unlimited)

Kafka.title: Kafka Message Bus
Kafka.description: Apache Kafka message bus integration for broker-to-broker cluster message routing

Servers.title: Kafka Bootstrap Servers
Servers.description: Comma-separated list of Kafka bootstrap brokers (e.g. 'localhost:9092,kafka2:9092')

Bus.title: Kafka Bus Options
Bus.description: Kafka event bus configuration for cluster synchronization

Enabled.title: Enable Kafka Bus
Enabled.description: Route internal broker cluster traffic over Kafka instead of Hazelcast

Topic.title: Bus Topic
Topic.description: Kafka topic used for inter-broker message exchange

Zenoh.title: Zenoh Broker Federation
Zenoh.description: Zenoh publication federation between independent MonsterMQ brokers

Mode.title: Zenoh Mode
Mode.description: Peer uses multicast discovery without a locator; client connects to the configured Zenoh endpoints

Connect.title: Zenoh Endpoints
Connect.description: Explicit Zenoh endpoints (e.g. tcp/192.168.1.10:7447); required in client mode and optional in peer mode

RemotePrefix.title: Remote Prefix
RemotePrefix.description: Root namespace prefix for MQTT topics on the Zenoh network. Set to empty string to federate directly under all Zenoh keys.

LocalPrefix.title: Local Prefix
LocalPrefix.description: Mount point prefix inside the local MQTT broker (e.g. data/zenoh)

Allow.title: Allow Filter
Allow.description: Topic filters allowed for Zenoh publication federation

Deny.title: Deny Filter
Deny.description: Topic filters blocked from Zenoh publication federation

Deduplication.title: Deduplication
Deduplication.description: Inbound deduplication cache to prevent message loop feedback

CacheSize.title: Cache Size
CacheSize.description: Maximum message fingerprints cached for deduplication

TtlSeconds.title: TTL Seconds
TtlSeconds.description: Time-to-live for deduplication fingerprints in seconds

DefaultStoreType.title: Default Store Type
DefaultStoreType.description: Default database backend for all persistent stores (sessions, queues, archives, metrics, users) unless overridden individually. SQLITE requires zero external setup.

SessionStoreType.title: Session Store Type
SessionStoreType.description: Storage backend for MQTT client sessions and subscriptions. Set to DEFAULT (or omit) to inherit from DefaultStoreType.

QueueStoreType.title: Queue Store Type
QueueStoreType.description: Storage backend for offline QoS 1/2 queued messages. Set to DEFAULT (or omit) to inherit from DefaultStoreType.

QueueVisibilityTimeoutSeconds.title: Queue Visibility Timeout
QueueVisibilityTimeoutSeconds.description: Visibility timeout in seconds for persistent queue stores. Messages delivered to clients but not ACKed within this window become visible again for redelivery.

MaxQueuedMessagesPerClient.title: Max Queued Messages Per Client
MaxQueuedMessagesPerClient.description: Maximum number of queued offline messages per client in in-memory queues before dropping oldest messages (0 = unlimited).

RetainedStoreType.title: Retained Message Store Type
RetainedStoreType.description: Storage backend for MQTT retained messages. Set to DEFAULT to inherit from DefaultStoreType, MEMORY for in-RAM storage, or NONE to disable retained message persistence.

QueuedMessagesEnabled.title: Queued Messages Enabled
QueuedMessagesEnabled.description: Enable queuing of QoS 1 and QoS 2 messages for offline persistent MQTT sessions.

AllowRootWildcardSubscription.title: Allow Root Wildcard Subscription
AllowRootWildcardSubscription.description: Allow clients to subscribe to '#' (root wildcard). If false, SUBSCRIBE acknowledgements for '#' return failure (0x80) and the client remains connected.

Queues.title: Internal Queues & Batch Tuning
Queues.description: Internal queue capacity and batch configuration for high-load broker operations.

SubscriptionQueueSize.title: Subscription Queue Size
SubscriptionQueueSize.description: Queue capacity for subscription add/delete operations (default: 0, unbounded). Set a positive value for a bounded in-memory queue.

MessageQueueSize.title: Message Queue Size
MessageQueueSize.description: Queue capacity for outbound client message queue operations (default: 0, unbounded). Set a positive value for a bounded in-memory queue.

DatabaseBatchSize.title: Database Batch Size
DatabaseBatchSize.description: Batch/bulk size for database queue write/delete operations (default: 4,000). Larger batches improve write throughput.

MessageCacheSize.title: Message Cache Size
MessageCacheSize.description: Number of queued messages fetched and visibility-locked per persistent-session drain batch (default: 4,000).

Metrics.title: Broker Metrics & History
Metrics.description: Broker metrics collection and historical time-series storage configuration.

Enabled.title: Enable Metrics
Enabled.description: Enable periodic metrics collection for dashboard charts and monitoring.

StoreType.title: Metrics Store Type
StoreType.description: Metrics history backend. Set to DEFAULT (or omit) to inherit from DefaultStoreType, MEMORY for in-RAM history, or NONE to disable metrics history.

CollectionIntervalSeconds.title: Collection Interval (Seconds)
CollectionIntervalSeconds.description: How often broker metrics samples (rates, connections, memory) are collected.

RetentionHours.title: Retention Hours
RetentionHours.description: How long metrics history is retained before automatic purging.

MaxHistoryRows.title: Max Memory History Rows
MaxHistoryRows.description: Maximum in-memory metrics rows retained per metric kind when StoreType is MEMORY.

UserManagement.title: Authentication & Access Control (ACL)
UserManagement.description: User authentication, password hashing, and topic access control list (ACL) configuration

Enabled.title: Enable User Management
Enabled.description: Enable user authentication and ACL. When false, all clients have unrestricted access.

StoreType.title: User Store Backend
StoreType.description: Storage backend for user credentials and ACL rules. Set to DEFAULT (or omit) to inherit from DefaultStoreType.

CacheRefreshInterval.title: Cache Refresh Interval (Seconds)
CacheRefreshInterval.description: How often (in seconds) to reload user and ACL data from the database.

DisconnectOnUnauthorized.title: Disconnect Unauthorized Clients
DisconnectOnUnauthorized.description: Disconnect connected clients immediately when their credentials become invalid (e.g. disabled or password changed).

AclCheckOnSubscription.title: ACL Check On Subscription
AclCheckOnSubscription.description: When true (default), ACL is checked at subscribe time against the topic filter. When false (Mosquitto mode), wildcard subscriptions are allowed and ACL is evaluated per-message at publish time.

SSL.title: SSL / TLS Encryption
SSL.description: SSL/TLS certificate configuration for encrypted MQTT connections (TCPS and WSS). These settings are used by the MQTTS (TCPS) listener, and also serve as the fallback for the WSS listener when the optional 'WSS' override below is not set.

KeyStorePath.title: KeyStore File Path
KeyStorePath.description: Path to the keystore file containing the server certificate and private key. When KeyStoreType is PEM, this is the certificate (or fullchain) PEM file path instead.

KeyStorePassword.title: KeyStore Password
KeyStorePassword.description: Password for accessing the keystore file. Ignored when KeyStoreType is PEM.

KeyStoreType.title: KeyStore Format
KeyStoreType.description: Keystore format: JKS (Java KeyStore), PKCS12 / PFX / P12 (industry standard), or PEM (separate certificate + private key files, e.g. from Let's Encrypt/certbot).

KeyPath.title: Private Key File Path (PEM only)
KeyPath.description: Path to the private key PEM file. Only used when KeyStoreType is PEM.

ClientAuth.title: Client Certificate Verification
ClientAuth.description: Enables mutual TLS (mTLS) on the MQTTS (TCPS) listener by requesting/requiring a client certificate, verified against TrustStorePath. NONE is the default and matches prior behavior (no client certificate requested). Not applied to the WSS listener.

TrustStorePath.title: TrustStore / CA File Path
TrustStorePath.description: Path to a truststore (JKS/PKCS12) or a CA certificate PEM file (when TrustStoreType is PEM) used to verify client certificates when ClientAuth is REQUEST or REQUIRED.

TrustStorePassword.title: TrustStore Password
TrustStorePassword.description: Password for accessing the truststore file. Ignored when TrustStoreType is PEM.

TrustStoreType.title: TrustStore Format
TrustStoreType.description: Truststore format: JKS, PKCS12 / PFX / P12, or PEM (a single CA certificate file).

UseIdentityAsUsername.title: Use Certificate Common Name as Username
UseIdentityAsUsername.description: When ClientAuth is REQUEST or REQUIRED and the client presents a valid certificate, its Common Name (CN) is used as the authenticated identity and the password check is skipped. The matching user account still governs permissions and ACL rules, and a disabled account is rejected. Only applies to the MQTTS (TCPS) listener; has no effect if the client presents no certificate or if UserManagement is disabled.

AutoCreateUser.title: Auto-Create User For Certificate Common Name
AutoCreateUser.description: Only used together with UseIdentityAsUsername. When false (default), a certificate whose Common Name has no user account is rejected, so accounts must be created up front. When true, the account is created automatically on first connect with default, non-admin permissions.

WSS.title: WSS Listener Certificate Override
WSS.description: Optional independent certificate for the Secure WebSocket (WSS) listener. Falls back to the KeyStore settings above when not set. Use this when WSS should present a different certificate than MQTTS, e.g. a public domain certificate for WSS and an internal CA-issued certificate for MQTTS. There's no ClientAuth/TrustStore here since WSS stays server-authenticated TLS only.

KeyStorePath.title: KeyStore File Path
KeyStorePath.description: Path to the keystore file (or certificate/fullchain PEM file when KeyStoreType is PEM) for the WSS listener.

KeyStorePassword.title: KeyStore Password
KeyStorePassword.description: Password for accessing the WSS keystore file. Ignored when KeyStoreType is PEM.

KeyStoreType.title: KeyStore Format
KeyStoreType.description: Keystore format for the WSS certificate.

KeyPath.title: Private Key File Path (PEM only)
KeyPath.description: Path to the WSS private key PEM file. Only used when KeyStoreType is PEM.

MqttTcpServer.title: TCP Socket Tuning
MqttTcpServer.description: Low-level TCP server socket options for latency and throughput optimization

MaxMessageSizeKb.title: Max Message Size (KB)
MaxMessageSizeKb.description: Maximum MQTT message size in kilobytes. Messages exceeding this limit are rejected.

NoDelay.title: TCP NoDelay (Disable Nagle)
NoDelay.description: TCP_NODELAY - disables Nagle's algorithm for instant packet transmission and lowest latency.

ReceiveBufferSizeKb.title: Receive Buffer Size (KB)
ReceiveBufferSizeKb.description: Socket receive buffer size in kilobytes. Recommended: 512KB normal load, 1-2MB high load.

SendBufferSizeKb.title: Send Buffer Size (KB)
SendBufferSizeKb.description: Socket send buffer size in kilobytes. Should match receive buffer size.

MaxInFlightMessages.title: Max In-Flight Messages
MaxInFlightMessages.description: Maximum number of outstanding QoS 1/2 messages in flight per client for MQTT 3.1.1.

ServerReceiveMaximum.title: MQTT 5 Receive Maximum
ServerReceiveMaximum.description: Server inbound Receive Maximum advertised in CONNACK for MQTT v5.0 clients.

Logging.title: System Logging
Logging.description: System logging and in-memory circular log buffer configuration

Memory.title: In-Memory Log Buffer
Memory.description: In-memory circular buffer for live log viewer in web dashboard

Enabled.title: Enable In-Memory Logs
Enabled.description: Store live system logs in memory for dashboard viewing

Entries.title: Buffer Entries Count
Entries.description: Maximum number of log entries retained in circular buffer

BulkMessaging.title: Outbound Delivery Batching
BulkMessaging.description: Batch outbound message delivery to MQTT clients to reduce event loop overhead

Enabled.title: Enable Outbound Batching
Enabled.description: Enable batching of outbound messages to connected clients.

TimeoutMS.title: Flush Timeout (ms)
TimeoutMS.description: Flush partial delivery batches after this many milliseconds.

BulkSize.title: Batch Size
BulkSize.description: Flush delivery batches immediately when this many messages accumulate.

BulkProcessing.title: Inbound Worker Batching
BulkProcessing.description: Batch inbound publish processing and route messages through dedicated worker threads

Enabled.title: Enable Inbound Batching
Enabled.description: Enable worker-thread-based batch processing for inbound publishes.

TimeoutMS.title: Flush Timeout (ms)
TimeoutMS.description: Flush partial inbound publish batches after this many milliseconds.

BulkSize.title: Batch Size
BulkSize.description: Flush inbound publish batches when this many messages accumulate.

WorkerThreads.title: Worker Threads Count
WorkerThreads.description: Number of parallel worker threads used when BulkProcessing is enabled.

ConfigStoreType.title: Config Store Backend
ConfigStoreType.description: Database type for storing archive and device configuration. Set to DEFAULT (or omit) to inherit from DefaultStoreType.

Postgres.title: PostgreSQL Database Connection
Postgres.description: PostgreSQL database configuration. Supports all store types (sessions, retained messages, archives, metrics, users).

Schema.title: Database Schema
Schema.description: PostgreSQL schema name for storing MonsterMQ tables (defaults to 'public'). Automatically created if missing.

CrateDB.title: CrateDB Connection
CrateDB.description: CrateDB distributed SQL database connection settings

Url.title: JDBC URL
Url.description: JDBC connection URL for CrateDB (e.g. crate://localhost:5432/doc)

Database.title: Database Name
Database.description: MongoDB database name for MonsterMQ collections

ReadTimeoutMs.title: Read Timeout (ms)
ReadTimeoutMs.description: Socket read timeout in milliseconds for MongoDB operations (default: 60000)

SQLite.title: SQLite Local Database
SQLite.description: Embedded SQLite database configuration. Zero setup required, stores database files locally on disk.

Path.title: Database Directory / File Path
Path.description: Path to SQLite database directory or file (default: 'sqlite')

EnableWAL.title: Enable WAL Mode
EnableWAL.description: Enable WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) mode for superior concurrent read/write throughput.

RestApi.title: REST API Server
RestApi.description: REST API for publish, read, and subscribe. Hosted on the GraphQL HTTP server under /api/v1/. Includes Swagger UI at /api/v1/docs.

Enabled.title: Enable REST API
Enabled.description: Enable REST API endpoints on the HTTP server

MCP.title: Model Context Protocol (MCP) AI Server
MCP.description: Model Context Protocol server endpoint for direct integration with AI tools, IDEs, and assistants

Enabled.title: Enable MCP Server
Enabled.description: Enable MCP server HTTP endpoint for AI tool access

Port.title: MCP Port
Port.description: HTTP listening port for MCP server

Prometheus.title: Prometheus Metrics Server
Prometheus.description: Prometheus-compatible metrics exporter (/metrics) and range query API for Grafana integration

Enabled.title: Enable Prometheus
Enabled.description: Enable Prometheus metrics exporter HTTP server

Port.title: Prometheus Port
Port.description: Port for Prometheus metrics HTTP endpoint

RawQueryLimit.title: Raw Query Limit
RawQueryLimit.description: Maximum number of raw records returned for fine-grained sub-minute step queries

I3x.title: CESMII I3X Manufacturing API
I3x.description: CESMII I3X (Industrial Information Interoperability eXchange) REST API server for standardized manufacturing data access

Enabled.title: Enable I3X API
Enabled.description: Enable I3X standardized manufacturing API server

Port.title: I3X Port
Port.description: Port for I3X API HTTP endpoint

Dashboard.title: Web Dashboard Hosting
Dashboard.description: Embedded Siemens iX Web Dashboard configuration (served from GraphQL HTTP port)

Enabled.title: Enable Dashboard
Enabled.description: Enable serving the web dashboard UI

Path.title: Custom Dashboard Path
Path.description: Filesystem path to override dashboard files for live UI development. Leave empty to serve from embedded bundle.

GraphQL.title: GraphQL & Dashboard HTTP Server
GraphQL.description: HTTP server hosting the GraphQL API, Web Dashboard, and REST API

Port.title: HTTP Port
Port.description: Listening HTTP port for Web Dashboard and GraphQL API

Path.title: GraphQL Path
Path.description: HTTP route path for GraphQL queries, mutations, and WebSocket subscriptions

CorsEnabled.title: Enable CORS
CorsEnabled.description: Enable Cross-Origin Resource Sharing headers for browser apps

GenAI.title: Generative AI & Assistant
GenAI.description: Generative AI providers and assistant integration (LangChain4j)

Enabled.title: Enable GenAI
Enabled.description: Enable Generative AI providers and AI assistant features

Assistant.title: AI Assistant Configuration
Assistant.description: Built-in AI assistant for script editing, topic schema analysis, and troubleshooting

Provider.title: AI Provider
Provider.description: AI provider used by the assistant

Temperature.title: Temperature
Temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0.0 to 2.0, lower = more deterministic, higher = creative)

DocsPath.title: Documentation Path
DocsPath.description: Local path to markdown documentation directory for RAG context

Providers.title: Provider API Keys & Endpoints
Providers.description: API keys and custom endpoints for GenAI services (supports ${ENV_VAR} syntax)

ArchiveGroups.title: Archive Groups (Historical & Last-Value Storage)
ArchiveGroups.description: Rules for storing historical telemetry, last-values, and buffered queues for specific topic filters

Name.title: Group Name
Name.description: Unique identifier for this archive group (e.g. 'Default', 'Sensors', 'Telemetry')

TopicFilter.title: Topic Filters
TopicFilter.description: List of MQTT topic patterns matched by this archive group (e.g. ['#', 'sensors/#'])

RetainedOnly.title: Retained Messages Only
RetainedOnly.description: When true, only messages published with the RETAIN flag set will be archived

LastValType.title: Last Value Store Type
LastValType.description: Backend used to store and quickly read the latest value of each topic

ArchiveType.title: Historical Archive Backend
ArchiveType.description: Database backend used for long-term historical time-series storage

DatabaseConnectionName.title: Named DB Connection
DatabaseConnectionName.description: Optional named PostgreSQL or MongoDB connection if using multi-database configuration

RedisDbNumber.title: Redis DB Number
RedisDbNumber.description: Optional Redis database index (0-15) exposing this group's last-value cache via RedisServer

LastValRetention.title: Last Value Retention
LastValRetention.description: Time-to-live duration string for last-values (e.g. '1h', '30m', '7d', or null for infinite)

ArchiveRetention.title: Archive Retention
ArchiveRetention.description: Time-to-live duration string for historical records before purging (e.g. '30d', '365d', '1y')

PurgeInterval.title: Purge Interval
PurgeInterval.description: Duration interval between automatic database purge cycles (e.g. '1h', '24h')

PayloadFormat.title: Payload Format
PayloadFormat.description: Format for storing payloads. 'JSON' enables nested column indexing where supported.

QueueType.title: Store-and-Forward Buffer Type
QueueType.description: Store-and-forward buffer type: NONE (unbuffered direct write), MEMORY (RAM buffer), or DISK (persistent buffer)

QueueSize.title: Buffer Queue Size
QueueSize.description: Buffer queue capacity in number of messages before applying backpressure

BulkSize.title: Database Batch Size
BulkSize.description: Number of archived messages accumulated before executing a bulk database insert

BulkTimeoutMs.title: Database Batch Timeout (ms)
BulkTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait before flushing partial database write batches

QueueDiskPath.title: Disk Buffer Directory
QueueDiskPath.description: Filesystem path for persistent disk buffer files when QueueType is DISK

LastValReadOnly.title: Last Value Read Only
LastValReadOnly.description: When true, live topic value caching is disabled while keeping last values readable and queryable

ArchiveReadOnly.title: Archive Read Only
ArchiveReadOnly.description: When true, historical message recording is disabled while keeping history queries and analytics active

RedisServer.title: Redis Server Protocol Adapter
RedisServer.description: Redis-compatible protocol server allowing Redis clients (redis-cli, libraries) to read live MQTT topic values

SetRetained.title: Set Retained on Write
SetRetained.description: Set MQTT RETAIN flag when writing via SET command

PublishQos.title: Publish QoS
PublishQos.description: MQTT QoS level for SET publications

KeysLimit.title: Keys Limit
KeysLimit.description: Maximum keys returned by KEYS command

KafkaServer.title: Apache Kafka Server Protocol Adapter
KafkaServer.description: Kafka-compatible protocol listener allowing Kafka consumers and producers to bridge directly to MQTT topics

Streams.title: Stream Topic Mappings
Streams.description: Mappings between Kafka topic names and MQTT topic filters

AllowWrite.title: Allow Writes
AllowWrite.description: Allow Kafka producers to write to this stream

StoreType.title: Store Backend Override
StoreType.description: Database store override for this stream

Features.title: Feature Flags (Subsystems & Protocol Bridges)
Features.description: Enable or disable optional broker subsystems and device connectors. All features are enabled by default.

OpcUa.description: OPC UA client device connector for industrial telemetry and PLC integration

OpcUaServer.description: Embedded OPC UA server exposing MQTT topics as OPC UA nodes

MqttClient.title: MQTT Client Bridge
MqttClient.description: Outbound MQTT client bridge to remote cloud or edge brokers (AWS IoT, Azure, Mosquitto, MonsterMQ)

Kafka.title: Kafka Client Bridge
Kafka.description: Apache Kafka client connector for streaming data to Kafka topics

Nats.title: NATS Client Bridge

Redis.title: Redis Client Bridge
Redis.description: Redis client bridge for pub/sub and key-value caching

Telegram.title: Telegram Bot Bridge
Telegram.description: Telegram bot connector for alarm notifications and interactive chat commands

WinCCOa.title: WinCC OA Client
WinCCOa.description: Siemens WinCC Open Architecture integration via Java API

WinCCUa.title: WinCC Unified Client
WinCCUa.description: Siemens WinCC Unified integration via GraphQL WebSocket and Open Pipe

Plc4x.title: PLC4X Protocol Bridge
Plc4x.description: Apache PLC4X industrial protocol driver (Siemens S7, Modbus, Allen-Bradley, Beckhoff ADS, BACnet)

Neo4j.title: Neo4j Graph Database
Neo4j.description: Neo4j graph database connector for knowledge graph and topology mapping

JdbcLogger.title: JDBC Database Logger
JdbcLogger.description: Generic JDBC SQL logger for publishing telemetry into relational databases

SparkplugB.title: Sparkplug B Decoder
SparkplugB.description: Eclipse Sparkplug B specification decoder and payload parser

FlowEngine.title: Flow Engine
FlowEngine.description: Visual automation workflow and rule engine with JavaScript / Python script execution

Agents.title: AI Autonomous Agents
Agents.description: Autonomous AI agents for telemetry analysis and automated decision making

GenAi.title: GenAI Provider Management
GenAi.description: Generative AI provider connections (Gemini, Claude, OpenAI, Ollama, llama.cpp)

Mcp.title: MCP Server Management
Mcp.description: Model Context Protocol server for AI assistant tools

SchemaPolicy.title: Topic Schema Policies
SchemaPolicy.description: JSON Schema topic payload validation and schema enforcement policies

TopicNamespace.title: Topic Namespaces
TopicNamespace.description: Hierarchical topic namespace aliasing and multi-tenant isolation

DataCatalog.title: Data Catalog
DataCatalog.description: Semantic object types, instances, relationships, and i3X mappings

DeviceImportExport.title: Device Import / Export
DeviceImportExport.description: JSON / YAML device and gateway configuration backup, import, and export

Hmi.title: Embedded HMI Hosting
Hmi.description: Host custom HTML5 / SVG / JavaScript HMI dashboard views directly from the broker

I3xClient.title: i3X Manufacturing Client
I3xClient.description: CESMII i3X standardized manufacturing client bridge

Redfish.title: DMTF Redfish REST Server
Redfish.description: DMTF Redfish hypermedia REST API server and MQTT sensor mapping engine

HMI.title: Embedded HMI Hosting
HMI.description: Host custom HTML5 / SVG / JavaScript HMI dashboard views directly from the broker

Path.title: HMI Asset Path
Path.description: Filesystem path for HMI web asset files

MountPath.title: HMI Mount URL Subpath
MountPath.description: HTTP subpath where HMI dashboards are mounted

Redfish.title: DMTF Redfish REST API Server
Redfish.description: Expose standard DMTF Redfish REST endpoints under /redfish/v1

Port.title: Dedicated Listener Port
Port.description: Dedicated TCP port for Redfish REST. 0 to multiplex onto GraphQL/HTTP port (default 4000)

MountPath.title: Mount URL Subpath
MountPath.description: HTTP URL path prefix where Redfish APIs are mounted
